source: Written by the student from general nutrition knowledge. Calorie values are approximate typical values per serving (compare with USDA FoodData Central before citing).

records.title: Fresh whole fruit
records.note: Fresh whole fruit is a Fruit/Vegetable item. One piece or one cup is usually about 50 to 120 calories, so the calorie level is Low.

records.title: Vegetables and plain salads
records.note: Vegetables and plain salads are Fruit/Vegetable items, usually under 100 calories per serving, so the calorie level is Low. Creamy dressings and fried toppings add calories.

records.title: Plain cooked rice, pasta and noodles
records.note: Plain cooked rice, pasta and noodles are Grains. One cup cooked is usually about 200 calories, so the calorie level is Medium.

records.title: Bread and toast
records.note: Bread and toast are Grains. One plain slice is about 80 to 120 calories. Sandwiches and bagels with fillings are usually 250 to 500 calories.

records.title: Fried foods
records.note: Deep-fried foods absorb oil. A serving of fried chicken or fries is usually over 400 calories, so the calorie level is High. Fried meat or fish is still Protein.

records.title: Grilled, baked, steamed or boiled meat, fish, eggs and tofu
records.note: Grilled, baked, steamed or boiled meat, fish, eggs and tofu are Protein. One serving is usually 150 to 350 calories, so the calorie level is Medium.

records.title: Cakes, pastries, candy and chocolate
records.note: Cakes, pastries, candy and chocolate desserts are Snacks/Sweets. They are rich in sugar and fat, and one slice or serving is often over 400 calories, so the calorie level is High.

records.title: Water and unsweetened drinks
records.note: Water, black coffee and unsweetened tea have almost no calories. They are Beverage items and the calorie level is Low.

records.title: Sweetened and blended drinks
records.note: Sweetened and blended drinks are Beverage items. Calories vary a lot with ingredients and size, from about 100 for soda or juice to 400 or more for milkshakes. If the ingredients are not stated, the calorie level is uncertain.

records.title: Pizza, burgers and mixed dishes
records.note: One slice of cheese pizza is about 250 to 300 calories. A whole personal pizza or a burger meal can exceed 600 calories. Pizza is mostly bread-based, so Grains is the closest food type.

records.title: Milk, cheese and yogurt
records.note: Milk, cheese and yogurt are Dairy items. A glass of milk or one slice of cheese is usually under 150 calories, so Low. Cream, butter and large cheese portions are higher.
